message: Function has multiple exit doors — use single-exit control flow

evaluator_config.message_template: Function '{name}' has {count} exit doors — use single-exit control flow

rationale: Multiple exit points create invisible control flow. A reviewer must trace every path to understand what the function returns. A single exit makes the return value the function's explicit contract. Exit doors include: return, raise, sys.exit(), os._exit(). All functions MUST have exactly one exit point — no exceptions.
remediation: Refactor to a single terminal return. Prefer a continue-flag / staged assignment pattern for application logic.
